hypothesis: A first-span skill contrast whose full-answer recovery survives same-skill repairs supplies direct credit for that root only when its two possible later policies could take the same continuation action. Use the complete earlier-span repair cohort at sessions 5-8 and the already registered retrieval-competition states. The negative 91-question calibration and the previously scored later windows motivated this design.
controlled_direct_effect: For terminal activity probabilities p0 and p1 after the two possible first actions, retain min(1-p0,1-p1) of verified activity-minus-temporal root F1 credit for a temporal suffix and min(p0,p1) for an activity suffix. The unmatched probability mass earns zero local bonus; do not renormalize. For each suffix, divide summed signed survived-probes deltas by all questions in that window. All non-candidates, unavailable controls, competing explanations and unreproduced outcomes contribute zero. Add this signed bonus to the measured raw two-step root target; keep the original verified terminal fit. Generate the donor continuation probabilities in an inner leave-one-dialogue-out fit as previously registered. Never add the new bonus at the terminal step.
evaluation: Freeze six leave-one-dialogue-out root models and one deployment model once all first-span probes are complete. Evaluate literal mixtures of the four previously measured paths and later physically randomized pairs. Compare to the unchanged terminal-credit candidate, an extra intercept on its root logits matched on donor states to the new root use, the same features with raw F1 supervision only, original native and terminal PPO. Report root probabilities, focal F1, two-step HT, realized token costs and by-dialogue/type coverage. All later windows with an already published score at numeric freeze remain outside the strictly prospective estimate. Use >=.02 vs native and terminal, positive vs prior and rate and pure return, positive in at least four histories vs rate, positive HT vs native and terminal, at least 90% coverage of the original 466 on all six training histories to consider separate development and both locked benchmarks.
